mission: Design the fastest safe external event loop that removes dependence on human dot turns for monitoring/compilation/projection. Evaluate existing GitHub Actions, Supabase/Edge/cron/webhook infrastructure, separate unattended deterministic responsibilities from ChatGPT-required compute, and define a minimal deployable trigger loop with security/authority boundaries and falsifiers.
acceptance_criteria: unattended responsibilities vs ChatGPT-required compute separated
stale/planner/projection trigger path and falsifiers defined

contradictions_surfaced: True unattended observation/compilation can be externalized now, but full autonomous compounding still requires executable Planner generation N+1 and authorized worker compute/invocation.
Supabase Cron can run faster than GitHub schedule, but making it the canonical Git writer in v1 would add a new privileged cross-system credential and authority surface.
Generic stale recovery is desired but current generic lease/heartbeat policy is unproven; elapsed time alone cannot be used as stale evidence.
